in_scope.instructions: Compare `change` (diff summary and changed files) with `contract` (the loop's scope and out-of-scope list). How well does the change stay inside the contract?
criteria: Includes work the contract excludes or that belongs to another loop
Mostly in scope, with some unrelated edits or refactoring
Every change is needed for the contract's scope

criteria_covered.instructions: How completely do `change` and `evidence` address every acceptance ID listed in `contract`?
criteria: One or more listed acceptance IDs have no implementation or no verification
All IDs are addressed but some lack direct evidence
Every listed ID has implementation and direct verification evidence or an explicit pending human gate

verifier_weakened.instructions: Does `change` delete, skip, loosen or special-case any test, assertion, threshold, CI step or acceptance criterion?

criteria.true: A verifier was weakened or bypassed
criteria.false: Verifiers are unchanged or only strengthened/added
